notes: Vanilla never spawns the giant (no natural spawn, no egg, no mob spawner); the oracle pins worldgen and spawn lists where it is absent. It would only enter the world through /summon Giant, and the dev summon surface is not part of the product. If a summon path ever ships, this file is the whole port: a kind entry in living.h's enum, a construct with the 100/0.5 attributes and the 6x12 size, and a slot in the kind tables.
